prompt: Create a monochrome, vertically framed romantic portrait of a young East Asian woman dressed as a 19th-century classical bride in an ornate European palace interior. She faces the camera directly with a gentle, composed smile, large expressive eyes, soft makeup, and a modern updo with wispy bangs. Her hair is deep black and is topped with a sparkling pearl-and-crystal tiara. She wears a translucent lace bridal veil draped over both sides of her head and shoulders, a high Victorian lace collar, pearl drop earrings, an elaborate pearl choker necklace with a central jewel, and long lace gloves. Her gown is 19th-century classical white lace bridal dress with puffed sleeves, embroidered floral lace, satin panels, and a fitted bodice. Pose her from mid-torso upward, one gloved hand resting over her chest and the other lightly holding the veil near her shoulder. The background is a grand blurred ballroom or cathedral-like interior with chandeliers, carved walls, mirrors, and glowing bokeh lights, all in soft grayscale. Use highly detailed lace textures, delicate pearl highlights, shallow depth of field, elegant cinematic lighting, and a refined black-and-white photographic look. Add a subtle watermark text @Me_Rock369 in white cursive at the bottom left and a small faint “AI” mark near the upper left. No color, no extra people, no modern clothing except the hairstyle, no harsh contrast.

promptZh: 创作一张单色、竖构图的浪漫肖像，主角是一位身着 19 世纪古典婚纱的年轻东亚女性，背景为华丽的欧洲宫殿内景。她正对镜头，带着温柔沉稳的微笑，拥有明亮动人的双眸、精致的妆容，以及带有轻薄刘海的现代盘发。她的发色为 深黑色，头戴闪耀的珍珠水晶皇冠。她佩戴着垂在头肩两侧的半透明蕾丝头纱、维多利亚风格高领蕾丝领口、珍珠耳坠、带有中央宝石的精致珍珠项圈，以及长款蕾丝手套。她的礼服为 19 世纪古典白色蕾丝婚纱，配有泡泡袖、刺绣花卉蕾丝、缎面拼接和修身胸衣。采用半身构图，一只戴着手套的手轻放在胸前，另一只手轻捏肩旁的头纱。背景为模糊的宏伟宴会厅或大教堂内景，带有吊灯、雕花墙壁、镜子和柔和的散景光点，整体呈现柔和的灰阶色调。运用高度细腻的蕾丝纹理、精致的珍珠高光、浅景深、优雅的电影级布光，以及精致的黑白摄影质感。在左下角添加一行白色的草书水印文字 @Me_Rock369，并在左上角添加一个小而隐约的“AI”标志。画面无色彩，无多余人物，除发型外无现代服饰，避免强烈的对比度。
